parts.text: Practitioner: Have you had any falls in the last year? Interviewee: Oh, I've had a couple of wobbles.
Practitioner: Have you had any falls in the last year? Interviewee: Three times this year. The last one was in May, I slipped coming down the stairs.
Practitioner: And how is your mood been these last couple of weeks? Interviewee: Mustn't grumble. There's people worse off than me.
Practitioner: Lovely garden you've got. Interviewee: My neighbour does it now. Terrible weather for it this week though.
Practitioner: Can I ask how much you drink in a week? Interviewee: That's my own business, thank you. Put down that I'd rather not say.
Practitioner: So that's three falls this year, the last one in May on the stairs, is that right? Interviewee: Mm. Mm-hm.
